title: XViewRank: Overlap-Conditioned Score Fusion for LLM-Augmented Sparse Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.20122v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can reduce vocabulary mismatch in sparse retrieval by generating alternative views of a query. Once these views are searched independently, however, their ranked lists may be complementary, redundant, or affected by query drift, making fixed fusion suboptimal. We present XViewRank, a lightweight retrieval-side method for conditionally fusing BM25 results from an original query, a hypothesis view, and a step-back view. For each pooled candidate, XViewRank retains three normalized BM25 scores and three query-level overlaps between the retrieved result sets. A small nonlinear scorer uses the overlaps as context that changes how the view-specific scores are interpreted, without jointly encoding query and passage text. Under a matched-input protocol, XViewRank improves nDCG@10 and MAP numerically over reciprocal rank fusion on both TREC DL 2019 and 2020, with a statistically significant MAP gain on DL19. translated_title: XViewRank：面向大语言模型增强稀疏检索的重叠条件化分数融合
translated_abstract: 大语言模型可以通过生成查询的替代视图来缓解稀疏检索中的词汇不匹配问题。然而，当这些视图被独立检索后，其排序列表可能是互补的、冗余的，或受到查询漂移的影响，使得固定的融合方式并非最优。我们提出了XViewRank，这是一种轻量级的检索端方法，用于有条件地融合来自原始查询、假设视图和后退视图的BM25结果。对于每个汇集的候选文档，XViewRank保留三个归一化的BM25分数以及检索结果集之间的三个查询级重叠度。一个小型非线性评分器将重叠度作为上下文，用以改变对视图特定分数的解读方式，而无需联合编码查询和段落文本。在匹配输入协议下，XViewRank在TREC DL 2019和2020两个数据集上的nDCG@10和MAP指标在数值上均优于倒数排序融合（RRF），并在DL19上取得了统计显著的MAP提升。
tldr: 本文提出XViewRank，一种轻量级检索端方法，利用多个视图检索结果集之间的重叠度作为条件上下文来动态融合BM25分数，在TREC DL 2019/2020上优于倒数排序融合等固定融合方法。
en_tdlr: XViewRank is a lightweight retrieval-side method that conditions the fusion of BM25 scores from an original query and LLM-generated views on the overlap between retrieved result sets, outperforming fixed fusion methods like reciprocal rank fusion on TREC DL 2019/2020.
